>
[Dischoran Rubble](/Equipment.aspx?ID=3258)
</title>

<traits>
<trait label="Catalyst" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=791" />
<trait label="Consumable" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=564" />
<trait label="Magical" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=644" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Howl of the Wild](/Sources.aspx?ID=226) pg. 118

**Price** 18 gp

<row gap="medium">

**Usage** held in 1 hand

**Bulk** L
</row>

<row gap="medium">
<row gap="tiny"><row>**Activate**</row><row>[Cast a Spell](/Actions.aspx?ID=2734) (add 1 action)</row></row>

 

 

 
</row>

</column>

---

Rock fragments exposed to any [dischoran's](/MonsterFamilies.aspx?ID=490)sonic blasts can sometimes retain a portion of the attack's energy, trembling slightly whenever they are touched. When you cast [_noise blast_](/Spells.aspx?ID=1616) using a piece of _dischoran rubble_, the cacophony reverberates through the targets' forms for 1 round. If a creature that failed or critically failed its initial saving throw moves 10 feet or more on their next turn, it takes 2d10 additional sonic damage.

<column gap="tiny">

</column>
